question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
resolution_source: June 7-8 bilateral exchange: IRGC ballistic missiles at Ramat David Airbase (IDF confirmed damage, June 7) + IDF strikes on military and petrochemical targets in western and central Iran including Mahshahr facility (June 8). Two-way exchange within 48h. Confirmed by Reuters, CNN, CBS News, Al Jazeera, Times of Israel. IDF and IRGC both issued official statements. Resolution criteria fully satisfied.
